# REVLINE Mobile Diagnostics & Repair

REVLINE Mobile Diagnostics & Repair is a mobile automotive service serving Utah County and Salt Lake County.

Website: https://revlineutah.com/
Phone: +1-224-345-8151
Email: revlineutah@gmail.com

Core work:
- Mobile diagnostics and troubleshooting
- Electrical diagnostics and repair
- Programming and coding
- Adaptation and calibration
- General maintenance and repair
- Brake, battery, starter and alternator service
- RV / camper electrical and supported repair
- ATV / UTV / trailer service
- Supported lift, leveling, lighting, suspension and accessory installation

Coverage:
Utah County and Salt Lake County are the core service areas. Additional Utah locations may be considered depending on job and travel distance.

Public profiles:
